An error from the `parse` phase. `sakura explain V0013` prints this explanation offline.

The left side of `=` must be a `var` name or a field path on one (`u.email = e`).

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V0013_invalid_assign_target.sakura`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V0013_invalid_assign_target.sakura), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn first_to_zero() -> List<Int> {
  var xs = [1, 2]
  xs[0] = Some(0)
  xs
}
```
